question_text: Table 1 shows four statements and the names of four parts of a nephron. Put a tick (✓) in each box where the statement is true for that part of the nephron.
other_guidance: Table of correct ticks: ADH receptors are present — Distal convoluted tubule ✓, Collecting duct ✓; Water can be absorbed from the filtrate — Proximal convoluted tubule ✓, Distal convoluted tubule ✓, Collecting duct ✓; Blood is under high pressure — Glomerulus ✓; Glucose is absorbed from the filtrate — Proximal convoluted tubule ✓
